trial_history_honest_reds.result: 6 deploy iterations through the team build queue (hub builds hogging the single builder; Hobby plan = no deep rollback, 402). Defects found and fixed on the way: (1) missing catch-all rewrites -> NOT_FOUND; (2) bun bundles literalize import.meta.dir AND __dirname to the build machine -> ENOENT on the lambda at module load (nba-concept-graph eager singleton); (3) hono/vercel handle() computes a Web Response but never writes it to res -> request HANG (Vercel launcher warns 'write the response through res'). Fixes: Node-adapter entry writing through res; loader candidate chain (env > source tree > cwd layouts) with the sha256 pin still gating every load.
trial_history_honest_reds.lesson: lambda runtime = Node not bun; asset paths must be runtime-resolvable; adapters must write through res
